recentItems.title: WASH UP! Girl Talk: Caregiver Video (Zimbabwe English)
recentItems.description: WASH UP! Girl Talk is a Sesame Workshop initiative designed to bring stigma-fighting menstrual health lessons to pre-adolescent girls in sub-Saharan Africa and Latin America. Piloted in 2019 across 150 schools in rural Zimbabwe and now expanding to Kenya, Guatemala, Honduras, and El Salvador, WASH UP! Girl Talk provides teachers and learners with menstrual health and puberty education, helping to destigmatize the issue and keep girls in school. Sesame's WASH UP! Girl Talk ambassador is Didi, an empowered and knowledgeable character, who serves as a positive role model for girls and boys, guiding them through fun activities, animated videos, and more. This video introduces parents and primary caregivers to the program and what their children will learn.

recentItems.title: Ahlan Simsim: A Typical School Day
recentItems.description: How do you make an episode about what it's like to be in first grade when your characters aren't old enough to go to school? Our lead characters in Ahlan Simsim, Basma and Jad, are "almost six," so they haven't yet experienced a full day of school — just like many of the kids in our audience of over 27 million children across the Middle East/North Africa. So we wrote a story where Basma and Jad's friend Ameera, who's 8 years old, told them all about what happens during a typical school day.

recentItems.title: How Sesame Workshop Brings Playful Learning to Conflict Zones
recentItems.description:
Learn how Sesame Workshop’s “Play to Learn” program is supporting young children in regions affected by crisis and conflict around the world. 
 
1 in 6 children lives in a conflict zone—and that number continues to grow. In partnership with BRAC, the International Rescue Committee, and the LEGO Foundation, Sesame Workshop is reaching over 30 million children and their caregivers with playful educational content that helps them learn, grow, and thrive. From Bangladesh and Ukraine to East Africa, Latin America, the Middle East and beyond, learn how Play to Learn is making a meaningful impact on families and communities worldwide.

recentItems.title: أهلًا سمسم: مَشروع رائد لتنمية مرحلة الطفولة المبكرة
recentItems.description: أهلًا سمسم هو المَشروع والبرنامج الرائد والمُبتَكَر الذي تقوده وتنفِّذه مؤسّستا "ورشة سمسم"  و"اللجنة الدّوليّة للإغاثة"، ويقدّم البرنامج خدمات الرعاية والتّعليم المبكّر لكل من الأطفال ومقدمي الرّعاية المتأثّرين بالنّزاع أوالنّزوح في منطقة الشّرق الأوسط. من خلال إصدار النسخة المحليّة الجديدة من البرنامج الشّهير "سسمي ستريت" والذي يحمل اسم البرنامج " أهلًا سمسم"، بالإضافة إلى مجموعة واسعة من الخدمات المباشرة في كلّ من العراق والأردنّ ولبنان وسوريا، فإن هذا البرنامج يهدف إلى الوصول للأطفال والعائلات أَينما كانوا ابتداء من الغرف الصّفيّة  ومرورًا بالعيادات الصّحيّة إلى التّلفاز وأجهزة الهاتف المحمولة؛ ليقدّم لهم المحتوى التعليميَّ الأساسيَّ الذي هم بأمسّ الحاجة إليه؛ للازدهار وتحقيق الرفاه. وهذا البرنامج الذي تمولّه كل من مؤسّسة "جون د. وكاثرين ت. ماك آرثر" (John  و"مؤسسة ليغو" لا يهدف فقط  إلى الاستجابة للاحتياجات العاجلة وإلى بناء أساس قويّ للرفاه في المستقبل، وإنما يحمل أيضًا إمكانية تغيير النظرة لنظام الاستجابة الإنسانيةّ للأزمات في أنحاء العالم كافّة.

recentItems.title: Ahlan Simsim: A Groundbreaking Early Childhood Intervention
recentItems.description:
Hear directly from a Syrian father and an educator who’ve experienced the transformative impact of Ahlan Simsim, our initiative with the International Rescue Committee bringing early learning and nurturing care to children affected by conflict and crisis in the Middle East.
 
Ahlan Simsim reaches children and families wherever they are—from classrooms, health clinics, and learning centers to TVs and mobile devices—through programming integrating direct services for families with award-winning educational media, including a locally produced version of Sesame Street. As the single largest early childhood intervention in the history of humanitarian response, Ahlan Simsim serves as a model for addressing the profound crisis for children affected by conflict, wherever they may be.
 
Learn more at sesameworkshop.org
